name: Terrance
source:
Smart, 100% professional and seemingly dispassionate, this Guiding Light employee is more than he appears. Despite working for the mega corporation, he gives the impression of someone who cares about biots and doesn't agree with GL's unethical practices.

Likes: When everything goes according to plan, quality food, to be right, reading
Dislikes: Disappointing people he cares about, infringement of boundaries, talking too much

[From [url=https://www.syntheticlover.com/press-kit/]official website[/url]]
